scenarios.title: Routine transfer to a known beneficiary
Social engineering: remote-access app (screen sharing) active during a large transfer
Transfer to a mule account that shares devices with confirmed fraud accounts
Authorised push payment / investment scam: amount far above usual to a new, very young account
Account takeover: new rooted device, VPN, foreign IP and wrong PINs before the transfer
Account number pasted several times into the beneficiary field (coached by a scammer)
Very high-value transfer to a known beneficiary from the usual device
Beneficiary name matches the sanctions list (fictional demo names)
Credential stuffing / brute force: logins from unknown devices abroad with many failures
SIM swap / phishing: phone or email changed from a new device abroad
